hero.body: Pandie Foundation ihagararira abana batishoboye muri Sierra Leone yose — itanga uburezi, imirire, ubuvuzi, n'ubushyuhe bw'agaciro ka muntu.

core.body: Dufasha abana batishoboye muri Sierra Leone binyuze muri gahunda zikemura buri kintu cyose cy'ubuzima bw'umwana — kuva ku kubaho kugeza ku kuvumbura no gushyira ahagaragara ubushobozi bwabo budasanzwe.

about: Ibyerekeye Pandie Foundation
Nyina wa bose
Umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta wita ku bantu, wiyemeje kurinda no kuzamura
abana batishoboye muri Sierra Leone binyuze mu burezi, imirire,
ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi, n'ubwitange bwuje impuhwe.
Ibyo Twagezeho
Buri Mibare Ni Umwana Ubuzima Bwe Bwahindutse
Abana baterwa inkunga
kandi baracyiyongera
Gahunda zikora
muri Sierra Leone yose
Ibihugu byagezweho
USA na Sierra Leone
Ubushyuhe mu gutanga inkunga
buri senti yose irabarwa
"Inshingano yacu iroroshye ariko irihutirwa:
kwemeza ko nta mwana n'umwe ubuzwa amahirwe yo gukura, kwiga, no gutera imbere
gusa kubera ko yavukiye mu buzima bugoye."
Iyi ni yo myumvire yabyaye Pandie Foundation — n'isezerano rituma dukora ibyo dukora byose.
Washinze Umuryango
Washinze & Umuyobozi Mukuru
Sierra Leone — Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika
Ubutumwa buvuye ku Washinze
Nashinze Uyu Muryango Kuko Nabonye Imibabaro Imbonankubone
Nkurira muri Sierra Leone, nabonye abana buzuye ubwenge, ubuhanga,
n'inzozi — abatafite inzira imbere kubera ubukene gusa.
Nabonye imiryango yakundaga abana bayo cyane
ariko ntibashoboraga kwishyura amafaranga y'ishuri, imiti, cyangwa n'ibiryo.
Njyanye ayo maso mu buzima bwanjye.
Igihe nashinze Pandie Foundation, nayise izina rya mama,
Pandie Grace Bangura — umugore watanze ibyo yari afite byose
ku muntu wese wabikeneye, akenshi mbere y'uko yiyitaho.
Yanyigishije ko impuhwe zitagira iherezo,
kandi ko urukundo rwa mama rugomba kugera ku mwana wese urukeneye.
Uyu muryango ni isezerano ryanjye kuri we — no ku mwana wese muri Sierra Leone
ukwiye amahirwe amwe n'ayo nahawe.
Ndashimira buri muterankunga, umukorerabushake, n'umufatanyabikorwa
wahisemo gufatanya natwe muri ubu butumwa.
— Washinze & Umuyobozi Mukuru
Mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro
Umutima n'ubugingo by'uyu muryango
Izina ryihishe inyuma y'Umuryango
Icyubahiro cy'umuhungu ku rukundo rwa nyina rudashira
Pandie Grace Bangura si umubyeyi w'abana be gusa.
Ni umubyeyi wa buri wese umukikije.
Mu muryango aho benshi bafite bike, atanga ubuntu —
igihe cye, ibiryo bye, ubushyuhe bwe, imbaraga ze, n'impuhwe ze.
Abonye umwana ashonje akamugaburira.
Ntabwo abaza icyo azahabwa mu kugaruka.
Ubuzima bwe bwo kurera no gutanga byahumekeye izina Pandie,
risobanura "Nyina wa bose."
Uyu muryango washinzwe mu rwego rwo kumwubaha kandi uhagarara nk'ikimenyetso gikomeza
impuhwe agaragaza buri munsi,
akageza urukundo rwe ku mwana wese urukeneye.
"Yizeraga ko buri mwana wese afite agaciro — atari abe gusa — kandi ko ubugwaneza nyabwo bupimwa n'uburyo twita ku bafite bike cyane."
— Joseph Allan Kamara, Washinze
Urugendo Rwacu
Kuva ku Nzozi kugera ku Rugendo
Itangiriro
Icyerekezo Kiravutse
Joseph Allan Kamara, ukomoka muri Sierra Leone, abona imibabaro y'abana batishoboye kandi afite icyizere gikomeye ko hari ikintu kigomba gukorwa.
Ihumure
Yiswe Izina rya Mama
Uyu muryango wiswe izina mu rwego rwo guha icyubahiro Pandie Grace Bangura — umugore urukundo rwe rwo kwitanga n'impuhwe ze ku bandi bikomeza kurema umutima w'ubu butumwa.
Umuryango
Pandie Foundation Yashinzwe
Pandie Foundation yashinzwe ku mugaragaro nk'umuryango utegamiye kuri Leta wita ku bantu, wiyemeje gufasha abana batishoboye muri Sierra Leone binyuze mu burezi, imirire, n'ubuvuzi.
Gahunda
Gahunda Z'ingenzi Esheshatu Zatangiye
Gahunda zo Gushyigikira Uburezi, Gushyigikira Imirire, Ubufasha bw'Ubuvuzi, Kurinda Abana, Gutera Inkunga Abana, na Gahunda zo Kugera ku Baturage zaratunganijwe kandi ziratangira.
Ejo Hazaza
Kwaguka kugira ngo bigire ingaruka zikomeye
Ku bufatanye n'abaterankunga, abakorerabushake, n'abafatanyabikorwa ku isi hose, Pandie Foundation iragura ibikorwa byayo kandi yubaka ejo hazaza aho nta mwana uzasigara inyuma.
Ukuri Duhanganye Nako
Inyuma ya buri mibare hari umwana ufite izina
Muri za kominote nyinshi muri Sierra Leone, abana bahura n'imbogamizi
zishobora kubangamira ejo hazaza habo kuva bakivuka.
Ibi si ibibazo bya kure — birimo biba ubu,
ku bana nyabo bafite inzozi nyazo.
Umwana Ushaka Kwiga
Abana mbere y'izuba rigasohoka akagenda ibirometero byinshi ajya ku ishuri,
gusa akicara mu ishuri nta bitabo by'ishuri bihari,
nta n'icyizere ko azagaruka ejo
niba umuryango we udashoboye kwishyura amafaranga y'ishuri.
Umwana Uryama Ashonje
Afite imyaka icyenda kandi asanzwe azi
uko kumva umuntu yiga ashonje bimeze.
Rimwe na rimwe, ikintu kimwe gusa kiri hagati ye n'inda irimo ubusa
ni igikombe kimwe cy'umuceri.
Umwana Ukeneye Ubuvuzi
Amaranye umuriro icyumweru.
Nyina azi icyo yakora ariko ntabwo afite ubushobozi bwo kugura imiti.
Arabasenga, areba, kandi ategereje —
kuko ikindi cyakorwa kidashoboka.
Ibi si imibare ya kure. Aba ni abana nyabo bafite inzozi nyazo.
Ejo hazaza habo haterwa n'uko umuntu — ahantu runaka — ahitamo kubitaho.
Pandie Foundation ibaho kugira ngo ibe uwo muntu.
Intego Yacu
Kwemeza ko nta mwana n'umwe ubuzwa amahirwe yo gukura, kwiga,
no gutera imbere gusa kubera ko yavutse mu buzima bugoye.
Dutanga uburezi, imirire, ubuvuzi, n'uburinzi —
dufata buri mwana nk'aho ari uwacu.
Icyerekezo Cyacu
Sierra Leone — ndetse na Afurika muri rusange —
aho nta mwana n'umwe wibagirana, nta mwana n'umwe uhatirwa kureka amashuri,
kandi buri mwana akura azi ko ubuzima bwe bufite agaciro
n'ejo hazaza he bikwiye kurwanirwa.
Icyo Dukora
Uburyo Butandatu Duhindura Ejo Hazaza h'Umwana
Twibanda ku byangombwa bituma umwana atarokoka gusa ahubwo anatera imbere.
Buri gahunda dutegura iyoborwa n'ihame rimwe: fata buri mwana nk'aho ari uwacu.
Inkunga y'Uburezi
Amafaranga y'ishuri, ibikoresho, imyenda y'ishuri, n'ibindi bikoresho kugira ngo nta mwana n'umwe ubura kwiga.
Imirire n'Ibiryo
Amafunguro yuzuye n'ubufasha bw'ibiryo kugira ngo inzara itazigera ihagarara hagati y'umwana n'ejo hazaza he.
Ubuvuzi
Ubuvuzi n'ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi ku bana barwaye indwara zishobora kwirindwa no kuvurwa.
Kurinda Abana
Ubuvugizi, umutekano, n'amashami y'icyubahiro ku bana bari mu kaga ko kwirengagizwa no gukoreshwa nabi.
Gutera Inkunga Umwana
Inkunga y'igihe kirekire y'umuntu ku giti cye ihuriza abaterankunga batanga ku mugaragaro n'urugendo rw'umwana.
Kugera ku Muryango
Gukorana bya hafi n'imiryango, abayobozi b'ibanze, n'amashuri kugira ngo habeho impinduka zirambye.
Reba Gahunda Zose
Indangagaciro Zacu
Ikiyobora Ibikorwa Byacu Byose
Ubunyangamugayo
Kuba inyangamugayo no kubazwa ibintu byose — buri kintu cyakoreshejwe mu buryo buboneye kandi gifite intego.
Impuhwe
Buri cyemezo gifatwa hagamijwe imibereho myiza y'abana n'imiryango ishyirwa ku mwanya wa mbere.
Icyubahiro
Guha agaciro icyubahiro cya buri mwana, buri muryango, na buri muryango dufite amahirwe yo gukorera.
Akamaro
Twiyemeje impinduka zirambye, zihamye — atari ubufasha bw'igihe gito gusa, ahubwo ejo hazaza hahindutse.
Uzitabira ubutumire?
Ahantu runaka muri Sierra Leone Iki joro, umwana arategereje ibyiringiro.
Abashyigikiye, abafatanyabikorwa, n'abaterankunga baba igice cy'umuryango mpuzamahanga
biyemeje kurinda abana no kugarura ibyiringiro aho byari byarabuze.
Buri musanzu ufasha gutanga ibikoresho by'ishuri, amafunguro, ubuvuzi,
n'ibidukikije birinzwe kugira ngo abana bakure bafite icyizere n'agaciro.
Iyo ushyigikiye Pandie Foundation, ntabwo uba utanga amafaranga gusa.
Uba winjiye mu ruhare Pandie Grace Bangura
akomeza kwigaragaza buri munsi —
umurinzi, utanga ubufasha, n'isoko ry'ibyiringiro ridashidikanywaho.
Tanga ubufasha ubu — Hindura ubuzima.
Jya Urugere
"Pandie Foundation — Nyina wa bose — ihagarariye impuhwe zidafite imbibi n'ibyiringiro bidafite iherezo."
stories: Ibi si imibare. Aba ni abana bafite amazina, amajwi, inzozi — n'ejo hazaza hahindutse kuko hari uwahisemo kubitaho.

Aminata yakundaga ishuri, ariko nyina yagorwaga no kubona ibitabo, ibikoresho, n'ibikenewe by'ibanze bya buri munsi. Rimwe na rimwe yajyaga ku ishuri ahangayitse ko ashobora kuzahagarika. Binyuze muri Pandie Foundation, yabonye ibikoresho by'ishuri, inkunga, n'icyizere cyo gukomeza. Uyu munsi yicaye mu ishuri afite ibyiringiro bishya — n'inzozi.
Aminata yakundaga ishuri ariko nyina ntiyashoboraga kubona ibikoresho. Ku nkunga ya Pandie yabonye ibitabo, imyenda y'ishuri, n'icyizere gishya cyo gukomeza.
Ubu ndashobora gutekereza neza mu ishuri.
Musa yajyaga ku ishuri ashonje buri munsi. Gahunda yo kugaburira yamuhaye amafunguro ya buri munsi kandi ihindura ubushobozi bwe bwo kwibanda no kwiga.
Nazamuye ukuboko kwanjye mu ishuri bwa mbere.
Hawa yari afite umuhate ariko yari abuze ibikoresho. Ibitabo, ibikoresho, n'inkunga bya Pandie byamuhaye icyizere cyo kwitabira byuzuye.
Indwara ishobora kwirindwa yatumye Mariama aguma mu rugo ibyumweru byinshi. Ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi binyuze muri Pandie bwamuvuje kandi amugarura mu ishuri.
Ibrahim yahuye n'uburangare mu rugo. Gahunda yo kurinda yamuhaye umutekano, inkunga, n'abantu bakuru bamwitayeho buri gihe.
Ibikoresho by'ibanze — igikapu cy'ishuri, amakaramu, imyenda y'ishuri — byahinduye uko Kadiatu yiyumvaga ajya ku ishuri buri gitondo.
Impano yawe yandika igice gikurikiyeho ku mwana muri Sierra Leone.
events: Buri gikorwa ni igikorwa cy'ubwitange butaziguye — kizanira ibiryo, uburezi, ubufasha bw'ubuvuzi, n'ibyiringiro abana babikeneye cyane.
Ubukangurambaga bw'Abaturage bwo Gusubira ku Ishuri
Fatanije natwe ushyire ikirango cyawe inyuma y'ubutumwa bufite agaciro. Abaterankunga b'ibigo bahabwa icyubahiro, raporo, n'ubumenyi ko inkunga yabo yageze ku bana nyabo.
contact: Niba ushaka gutanga inkunga, gufatanya, gukorera ubushake, cyangwa kumenya byinshi gusa — turi hano kandi twishimiye kuvugana nawe.

Hari ikitagenda neza. Nyamuneka ongera ugerageze.
getInvolved: Buri muntu winjira muri ubu butumwa — nk'umuterankunga, umukorerabushake, umufatanyabikorwa, cyangwa umuvugizi — aba umwe mu muryango utarebera umwana ukennye.
Tanga inkunga y'amafaranga — rimwe cyangwa buri kwezi — kandi utere inkunga itaziguye uburezi, imirire, ubuvuzi, n'uburinzi bw'abana muri Sierra Leone.
Iyemeze gushyigikira urugendo rw'umwana umwe. Inkunga yawe ya buri kwezi itanga ituze, agaciro, n'ejo hazaza bashobora kwizera.
Ibigo n'imiryango bishobora gufatanya na Pandie Foundation mu bikorwa bya CSR, ibirori byateguwe n'abafatanyabikorwa benshi, no gutanga raporo z'ingaruka.
Tanga igihe cyawe, ubumenyi, cyangwa ubuhanga bwawe bw'umwuga — uri kure cyangwa imbonankubone — kugira ngo ukomeze ubutumwa n'ibikorwa byacu.
Sangiza ubutumwa bwacu ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, n'umuryango wawe, cyangwa n'umukoresha wawe. Kumenyekanisha bituma haboneka abaterankunga kandi abaterankunga barokora ubuzima.
Huza ikirango cyawe n'impamvu ifite agaciro. Porogaramu zo gutanga z'abakozi, impano zihura, n'ubufatanyabikorwa byose birakira.
Ntabwo ukeneye kuba umukire ngo ugire icyo uhindura. Ukeneye gusa kwitaho. Icyo cyose ushobora gutanga — igihe, amafaranga, ijwi, cyangwa ubuhanga — gifite agaciro kurusha uko ubizi.
donate: Kuba mwaraje hano — mwiteguye gutanga — bisobanuye byinshi kuri twe kurusha uko mubyiyumvisha. Urupapuro rwacu rwo gutangiraho imfashanyo kuri interineti rurimo kubakwa ubu kugira ngo buri mpano igere ku mwana mu buryo bwizewe kandi butekanye.
Gutanga kuri interineti bizatangira vuba cyane. Kugeza icyo gihe, niba umutima wanyu ubashishikariza gufasha umwana uyu munsi, twishimira cyane kumva amakuru yanyu mu buryo butaziguye.
Tanga Imfashanyo Uyu Munsi Ukoresheje Imeyili
Tubwire uburyo mwifuza gufasha — impano y'igihe kimwe, gutera inkunga buri kwezi, cyangwa gutera inkunga umwana runaka — kandi itsinda ryacu rizabafasha mu buryo bwihariye.
“Buri mwana ugezweho, buri funguro ritanzwe, buri buzima buzamuwe — byose bitangirira ku mutima umeze nk'uwanyu wahisemo kwitaho.”
